source: https://www.ers.usda.gov/media/5497/unemployment-and-median-household-income-for-the-united-states-states-and-counties-2000-23.csv (USDA ERS republication of BLS Local Area Unemployment Statistics annual county averages)
method: Each county's annual average unemployment rate minus its state's, every county-year 2010 to 2019; percentiles of the difference in percentage points. Counties with a labor force under 10,000 reported separately.
